meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 装上后，当接到开发任务时，Claude 会先把它拆成多个小型可独立合并的 PR，在独立工作目录中逐个实现，用真实环境手动验证并留档，然后创建英文 PR，等 CI 和自动审查通过后自动合并。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“implement issue”等要求，或语境表明要把任务以 PR 交付（哪怕只说“implement X”）时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 实现并创建一个 PR
say.note: 会先拆成小 PR 再逐个落地

say.text: 把这项功能拆成几个独立的小 PR 并行做
say.note: Claude 会为每个 PR 建独立工作区并发推进

say.text: 实现并提交这个 PR，验证通过后合并
say.note: 默认自动合并，失败会回到修复循环

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude decomposes a task into small independently mergeable PRs, implements each in a separate worktree with evidence-bound manual QA, creates English PRs, and auto-merges after CI and Cubic review pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "create a PR", "implement issue", or similar requests, or when the context implies delivering work as a PR (even just "implement X").

say_en.text: Implement this issue and create a PR.
say_en.note: It will break it down into small PRs first.

say_en.text: Split this feature into a few independent small PRs and work in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude uses one worktree per PR and runs them in parallel.

say_en.text: Implement and submit this PR, then merge after checks pass.
say_en.note: Auto-merge by default; failures loop back to fixes.
